subject: ENGLISH
descriptionUz: Multilevel Speaking bo'limiga to'liq tayyorgarlik: Part 1 shaxsiy savollari uchun PRE formulasi va tayyor ramkalar, ravonlik va talaffuz sirlari, Part 2 monologi, Part 3 munozarasi va imtihon kuni strategiyasi. Har darsda ovozli mashq bor — mikrofoningizni tayyorlang!

modules.descriptionUz: Part 1 shaxsiy savollariga ishonchli javob berish, pauzalarni tabiiy to'ldirish va o'zbek tilida yo'q tovushlarni to'g'ri talaffuz qilish.

lessons.titleUz: Part 1 mahorati: PRE formulasi bilan javob berish
objectivesUz: Part 1 formatini va baholash mantiqini tushunish
Har qanday shaxsiy savolga PRE (Point-Reason-Example) formulasi bilan 20-30 soniyalik javob qurish
PRE signal iboralarini avtomatizmgacha yodlash

content.bodyUz: Multilevel Speaking kompyuterda topshiriladi: savol ekranda chiqadi va ovoz bilan o'qiladi, siz mikrofonga javob berasiz. **Part 1** — siz haqingizdagi oddiy savollar: oila, sevimli mashg'ulot, ona shahar, ob-havo, o'qish. Har savolga taxminan **30 soniya** vaqt beriladi. Xatoning eng katta turi — bir so'zli javob: *«Yes, I do»* deb jim qolish ballni keskin tushiradi, chunki baholovchi tilingizni ESHITISHI kerak.

content.titleUz: PRE formulasi — har qanday savolga tayyor qolip
content.bodyUz:
Har javobni 3 qadamda quring:

1. **P — Point (fikr)**: savolga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob. *I'd say I really enjoy cooking.*
2. **R — Reason (sabab)**: nega shunday? *The main reason is that it helps me relax.*
3. **E — Example (misol)**: aniq hayotiy misol. *For example, last week I cooked plov for ten guests.*

3 gap = 20-30 soniya = ideal Part 1 javobi. Formula miyangizga o'rnashsa, hech qaysi savol sizni dovdiratmaydi.

turns.speaker: Examiner
turns.en: Do you like living in your hometown?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Yes, definitely. I really enjoy living in Samarkand because it offers a perfect mix of history and modern life. For example, after classes I often walk around Registan Square, and there are also plenty of cosy cafes where I meet my friends.
turns.uz: Ha, albatta. Samarqandda yashash menga juda yoqadi, chunki bu yerda tarix va zamonaviy hayot uyg'unlashgan. Masalan, darslardan keyin men tez-tez Registon maydonini aylanaman, do'stlarim bilan uchrashadigan shinam kafelar ham ko'p.

content.bodyUz:
Yuqoridagi javobda:

- **Point**: *Yes, definitely. I really enjoy living in Samarkand* — savolga aniq javob.
- **Reason**: *because it offers a perfect mix of history and modern life* — sabab.
- **Example**: *For example, after classes I often walk around Registan Square...* — shaxsiy, aniq misol.

E'tibor bering: javob atigi 3 gap, lekin unda bog'lovchi (*because*), yuqori daraja lug'ati (*a perfect mix of, plenty of, cosy*) va shaxsiy tafsilotlar bor.
Oltin qoida: Part 1 da javobingiz 2 gapdan qisqa va 5 gapdan uzun bo'lmasin. Juda uzun javobda mavzudan chiqib, xato qilish xavfi oshadi. PRE — 3 gap — 25 soniya. Shu ritmni tanangizga singdiring.

exercises.explanationUz: PRE = Point (fikr) + Reason (sabab) + Example (misol). Sabab javobingizga mantiq beradi.

order: I'd say I really enjoy cooking.
The main reason is that it helps me relax after a long day.

exercises.explanationUz: Avval fikr (Point), keyin sabab (Reason), oxirida misol (Example).

exercises.explanationUz: Reason qadami odatda because/since/as bilan kiritiladi.

data.statement: Part 1 da «Yes, I do.» kabi bir gapli javob yuqori ball olish uchun yetarli.

exercises.explanationUz: Bir gapli javob — yo'qotilgan imkoniyat. Baholovchi so'z boyligingiz va grammatikangizni eshitishi kerak: har savolga 2-4 gapli PRE javob bering.

exercises.promptEn: Part 1 question: 'What do you usually do in your free time?' Answer in 2-4 sentences using the Point-Reason-Example formula.
exercises.promptUz: Part 1 savoli: «Bo'sh vaqtingizda odatda nima qilasiz?» PRE formulasi bilan 2-4 gapli javob yozib oling.
exercises.explanationUz: Namuna skelet: I'm really into... (P) — It helps me... / because... (R) — For example, every Sunday... (E). O'zingizni tinglab, uch qadam ham borligini tekshiring.

lessons.titleUz: Fluency sirlari: pauza to'ldirgichlar va o'zini tuzatish
lessons.titleEn: Fluency secrets: fillers, self-correction and pace
objectivesUz: Jim pauza o'rniga tabiiy to'ldirgich iboralarni ishlatish
Xatoni to'xtamasdan, tabiiy iboralar bilan tuzatish
Barqaror, tushunarli tempda gapirishni mashq qilish

content.bodyUz: **Fluency (ravonlik)** — tez gapirish EMAS. Bu — uzun jim pauzalarsiz, tabiiy tempda, fikrni uzmasdan gapirish. Baholashda 3 soniyadan uzun jimlik xavfli signal sanaladi. Yaxshi yangilik: ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar ham doim o'ylab turadi — lekin ular jim turmaydi, **pauza to'ldirgichlar** ishlatadi. Shu kichik iboralar sizga o'ylash uchun 2-3 soniya sotib beradi va nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi.

items.en: What I meant to say was...
Let me put it another way.

turns.speaker: Examiner
turns.en: What kind of films do you enjoy watching?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Well, let me think... I'd say I'm mostly into science fiction. I watch... sorry, I mean I've watched almost every Christopher Nolan film, and what I love about them is that they keep you thinking long after the film ends.
turns.uz: Xo'sh, o'ylab ko'ray... Asosan ilmiy-fantastik filmlarga qiziqaman desam bo'ladi. Men ko'raman... kechirasiz, demoqchimanki, Kristofer Nolanning deyarli barcha filmlarini ko'rganman va ularda menga yoqadigani — film tugagandan keyin ham sizni o'ylantirib qo'yishi.

content.bodyUz: Ideal temp — soniyasiga taxminan **2 so'z**: na poyga, na sudralish. Tez gapirsangiz tovushlar yutilib, tushunarlilik yo'qoladi; sekin gapirsangiz fluency balingiz tushadi. Mashq usuli: 30 soniyalik javobni yozib oling va so'zlarni sanang — 50-65 so'z chiqsa, tempingiz joyida. Muhim: xato qilsangiz, TO'XTAMANG. Bitta tuzatish iborasi bilan tuzating va davom eting — imtihonda o'z-o'zini tuzata olish yuqori daraja belgisi sanaladi.

Ehtiyot bo'ling: bitta to'ldirgichni har gapda takrorlash (masalan, har gapda «you know») teskari ta'sir qiladi. 3-4 xil to'ldirgichni almashlab ishlating. Va «Errr... mmm...» cho'zish to'ldirgich emas — bu jimlikning boshqa turi xolos.

exercises.promptUz: Qaysi iboralar o'ylash uchun vaqt yutishga xizmat qiladi? (bir nechtasini belgilang)
exercises.explanationUz: «I don't know. Next question.» — javobdan voz kechish, ball yo'qotasiz. Qolgan uchtasi tabiiy pauza to'ldirgichlar.

data.text: My sister live... ___ , my sister lives in Tashkent.

exercises.explanationUz: «Sorry, I mean...» — xatoni sezib, to'xtamasdan tuzatishning standart yo'li.

data.text: That's an interesting ___ . Let me think for a second.

exercises.explanationUz: «That's an interesting question» — savolni maqtab, o'zingizga 2-3 soniya vaqt sotib olasiz.

left: What I meant to say was...

exercises.explanationUz: Har bir ibora o'z vazifasida ishlatilsa, nutqingiz ona tilidagidek tabiiy eshitiladi.

data.statement: Fluency (ravonlik) — imkon qadar tez gapirish demakdir.

exercises.explanationUz: Fluency — jim pauzalarsiz, barqaror tabiiy tempda gapirish. Haddan tashqari tezlik tushunarlilikni buzadi va talaffuz baliga zarar beradi.

exercises.promptEn: Speak for 45 seconds about your typical day. Use at least two different fillers (e.g. 'well...', 'let me think...') and correct yourself once on purpose using 'sorry, I mean...'.
exercises.promptUz: Oddiy kuningiz haqida 45 soniya gapiring. Kamida ikkita turli pauza to'ldirgich ishlating va bir marta ataylab «sorry, I mean...» bilan o'zingizni tuzating.
exercises.explanationUz: Yozuvni tinglang: 3 soniyadan uzun jimlik bo'ldimi? So'zlarni sanang — 45 soniyada 80-100 so'z bo'lsa, temp ideal.

lessons.titleUz: Talaffuz asoslari: o'zbek tilida yo'q tovushlar va so'z urg'usi
lessons.titleEn: Pronunciation basics: th, w/v, ng and word stress
objectivesUz: O'zbek tilida yo'q /θ/, /ð/, /w/ va /ŋ/ tovushlarini to'g'ri hosil qilish
So'z urg'usining ma'noni o'zgartirishini bilish va urg'uni to'g'ri qo'yish
Minimal juftliklar bilan mustaqil mashq qilish usulini o'rganish

content.bodyUz: Sizdan britancha aksent talab qilinmaydi! Baholanadigan narsa — **intelligibility**: aytganingiz qiyinchiliksiz tushuniladimi? Muammo shundaki, ayrim inglizcha tovushlar o'zbek tilida umuman yo'q, va biz ularni beixtiyor yaqin o'zbek tovushiga almashtiramiz: *think* → «sink», *water* → «vater». Ba'zan bu ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi — shuning uchun aynan shu 4 tovushni alohida mashq qilamiz.

rows: /θ/ — jarangsiz th (til uchi tishlar orasida)
think, three, thank, month
«s» yoki «t» deb aytish: *sink*, *tri*
/ð/ — jarangli th (xuddi shu holat, ovoz bilan)
this, that, mother, weather
«z» yoki «d» deb aytish: *zis*, *dat*
/w/ — lablar yumaloq, tishga TEGMAYDI
water, well, window, one
o'zbekcha «v» deb aytish: *vater* (lablar tishga tegib ketadi)
/ŋ/ — bitta burun tovushi
singing, morning, going
«n» + «g» deb ikkiga bo'lish yoki oddiy «n» deyish

content.bodyUz:
Inglizchada urg'u noto'g'ri qo'yilsa, so'z tanib bo'lmas holga keladi yoki ma'nosi o'zgaradi:

- **PRE**sent (ot) = sovg'a, lekin pre**SENT** (fe'l) = taqdim etmoq
- **PHO**tograph → pho**TO**grapher → photo**GRA**phic — o'zak bir xil, urg'u ko'chadi!
- -tion bilan tugagan so'zlarda urg'u doim -tion dan OLDINGI bo'g'inda: educa**TION** emas, edu**CA**tion.

Yangi so'z yodlaganda doim urg'usi bilan yodlang: lug'atda urg'u belgisi (ˈ) urg'uli bo'g'in OLDIDAN qo'yiladi: /fəˈtɒɡrəfə/.

items.uz: o'ylamoq — cho'kmoq: «th» da til uchi tishlar ORASIDA, «s» da tishlar ortida
uch — daraxt: «th» ni «t» deb aytsangiz ma'no o'zgaradi
g'arb — nimcha: /w/ da lablar yumaloq nayga o'xshaydi, tishga tegmaydi
vino — tok: oynada lablaringizni kuzatib mashq qiling
ozg'in — narsa: /ŋ/ da til orqasi yumshoq tanglayga ko'tariladi, /g/ eshitilmaydi

content.bodyUz: 5 daqiqalik kunlik ritual: oynaga qarab minimal juftliklarni 5 martadan ayting — til va lablaringizni KO'RING. «th» uchun tilingiz uchi ko'rinishi shart; «w» uchun lablaringiz o'pich shakliga kelsin. Telefoningizga yozib, lug'at talaffuzi bilan solishtiring. 2 haftada natija eshitiladi.

exercises.explanationUz: three /θriː/ — jarangsiz th. «this» — jarangli /ð/, «tree» va «sea» da th tovushi umuman yo'q.

exercises.promptUz: Qaysi so'zlar /w/ (lablar yumaloq, tishga tegmaydi) bilan boshlanadi? (bir nechtasini belgilang)
exercises.explanationUz: «village» va «very» /v/ bilan — lablar tishga tegadi. Kutilmagan a'zo: «one» /wʌn/ deb o'qiladi!
PHO-to-graph → pho-TO-gra-pher → en-gi-NEER. Bir o'zakli so'zlarda ham urg'u ko'chishi mumkin.

data.statement: «singing» so'zidagi «ng» ikkita alohida tovush — /n/ va /g/ — sifatida aytiladi.

exercises.explanationUz: «ng» — bitta burun tovushi /ŋ/: til orqasi yumshoq tanglayga ko'tariladi, /g/ alohida eshitilmaydi. /ˈsɪŋɪŋ/, «sing-ging» emas.

exercises.promptUz: Urg'u qoidasini to'ldiring (inglizcha so'z turkumini yozing):

data.text: When the stress is on the second syllable, 'preSENT' is a ___ .

exercises.explanationUz: PREsent (ot — sovg'a) urg'u 1-bo'g'inda; preSENT (fe'l — taqdim etmoq) urg'u 2-bo'g'inda. Ot-fe'l juftliklarida bu qoida tez-tez ishlaydi: REcord/reCORD, IMport/imPORT.

exercises.promptEn: Read these three sentences aloud, slowly and clearly: 1) I think these three things are worth thirty dollars. 2) We went for a walk and watched the waves. 3) She was singing and bringing something interesting.
exercises.promptUz: Uchala gapni sekin va aniq ovoz chiqarib o'qing: 1-gap «th», 2-gap «w», 3-gap «ng» tovushlariga qaratilgan.
exercises.explanationUz: Yozuvni tinglab tekshiring: th da til tishlar orasida bo'ldimi? w da lablar tishga tegmadimi? ng bitta tovush bo'lib chiqdimi? Xato joylarni belgilab, qayta yozing.

lessons.titleEn: Part 1: ready-made frames for the 10 most common topics
objectivesUz: Part 1 ning eng ko'p uchraydigan 10 mavzusini bilish
Har mavzu uchun universal ramka (frame) yodlab, shaxsiy ma'lumot bilan to'ldirish
Ramkalarni PRE formulasi bilan birlashtirish

content.bodyUz: Part 1 savollari yildan-yilga bir xil mavzular atrofida aylanadi: **oila, sevimli mashg'ulot, ona shahar, taom, ob-havo, o'qish/ish, do'stlar, sayohat, sport, kitob/kino**. Demak, imtihonga qadar har mavzu uchun **ramka** — boshlanishi tayyor, ichi bo'sh qolip — tayyorlab qo'yish mumkin. Imtihonda siz faqat bo'sh joylarni o'z hayotingizdan to'ldirasiz. Bu yodlangan matn emas: skelet sizniki, go'sht har safar yangi.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: There are five of us in my family — my parents, my two younger sisters and me. The person I'm closest to is my father, because we share the same sense of humour. For instance, every Friday evening we watch comedy shows together.
turns.uz: Oilamiz besh kishidan iborat — ota-onam, ikki singlim va men. Menga eng yaqini — dadam, chunki hazil tuyg'ularimiz bir xil. Masalan, har juma oqshomi birga komediya ko'rsatuvlarini tomosha qilamiz.

turns.speaker: Examiner
turns.en: What's the weather like in your country?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: To be honest, the weather in Uzbekistan is quite extreme — summers are boiling hot, while winters can be freezing. Personally, I prefer spring, because the whole city turns green and I can cycle to college every day.
turns.uz: Ochig'i, O'zbekistonda ob-havo ancha keskin — yozlari jazirama issiq, qishlari esa qattiq sovuq bo'lishi mumkin. Shaxsan men bahorni afzal ko'raman, chunki butun shahar ko'kalamzorga aylanadi va kollejga har kuni velosipedda bora olaman.

exercises.explanationUz: Bu javobda PRE bor: fikr + sabab + misol. «Yes.» va «I like.» juda qisqa, uchinchi variant esa savolga javob emas, lug'aviy ta'rif.

content.bodyUz: Part 2 da sizga vaziyat yoki ikki variantli mavzu beriladi (masalan: uyda o'qish yoki kutubxonada o'qish). Odatda **1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik** va **2 daqiqagacha gapirish** vaqti bo'ladi. Bu endi savol-javob emas — uzluksiz MONOLOG. Eng katta xavf: strukturasiz «oqib ketish» — 40 soniyadan keyin nima deyishni bilmay qolish. Yechim — har doim bir xil 4 bosqichli qolip.

rows: 1. Kirish va vaziyat tasviri

35-40 soniya
3. Kamchiliklar
On the downside, ... / However, one drawback is...
35-40 soniya

turns.speaker: Examiner
turns.en: Some students prefer studying at home, while others study at the library. Describe both options, talk about their advantages and disadvantages, and say which one you prefer.
turns.uz: Ba'zi talabalar uyda o'qishni, boshqalari kutubxonada o'qishni afzal ko'radi. Ikkala variantni tasvirlab, afzallik va kamchiliklarini aytib, qaysi birini afzal ko'rishingizni ayting.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: I'd like to talk about two popular ways of studying: at home and at the library. Nowadays both options are common among students in Uzbekistan.
turns.uz: Men o'qishning ikki mashhur usuli — uyda va kutubxonada o'qish haqida gapirmoqchiman. Bugungi kunda O'zbekiston talabalari orasida ikkala usul ham keng tarqalgan.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: One major advantage of studying at home is comfort — you can make tea, take a break whenever you like, and nobody limits your time. Another plus is that it is completely free.
turns.uz: Uyda o'qishning asosiy afzalligi — qulaylik: choy damlab, istagan payt tanaffus qilasiz, hech kim vaqtingizni cheklamaydi. Yana bir plyusi — bu mutlaqo bepul.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: On the downside, home is full of distractions: the TV, the fridge and, of course, the phone. The library, on the other hand, offers silence and a real working atmosphere, although its opening hours can be inconvenient.
turns.uz: Salbiy tomoni, uy chalg'ituvchi narsalarga to'la: televizor, muzlatgich va albatta telefon. Kutubxona esa sukunat va chinakam ish muhitini beradi, garchi ish vaqti noqulay bo'lishi mumkin.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: All things considered, I would personally opt for the library, because seeing other people study around me really motivates me to focus.
turns.uz: Hammasini hisobga olganda, men shaxsan kutubxonani tanlagan bo'lardim, chunki atrofimda o'qiyotgan odamlarni ko'rish meni jiddiy diqqatni jamlashga undaydi.

objectivesUz: Abstrakt savolga ikki tomonlama (balanced) javob qurish
On the one hand / on the other hand kabi kontrast iboralarni qo'llash
Hedging — fikrni yumshatish orqali C1 darajadagi munozara ohangini egallash

content.bodyUz: Part 3 savollari endi siz haqingizda emas — **jamiyat, texnologiya, ta'lim** kabi abstrakt mavzular haqida: *«Do you think technology makes people less sociable?»* Bunday savolga faqat «men va telefonim» haqida gapirish yetarli emas. Kuchli javob formulasi: **umumiy fikr → bir tomon → ikkinchi tomon → shaxsiy xulosa**. Aynan shu muvozanat B1 nomzodni B2-C1 dan ajratib turadi.

items.en: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...
While it's true that..., we shouldn't forget that...
Some people argue that..., whereas others believe...
items.uz: Ba'zilar ... deb hisoblaydi, boshqalar esa ... deb biladi
Bu ikki tomoni ham o'tkir qilich (har ikkala ta'siri bor)

content.bodyUz:
**Hedging** — qat'iy, mutlaq gaplardan qochib, fikrni yumshatish. Solishtiring:

- ❌ *Technology is bad. Everyone is addicted.* — dag'al, isbotlab bo'lmaydigan da'vo
- ✅ *Technology can sometimes have negative effects, and many people tend to overuse it.* — o'ylangan, akademik ohang

Hedging vositalari: *can, may, might, tend to, sometimes, to some extent, it seems that...* Ingliz akademik madaniyatida aynan yumshatilgan fikr kuchli hisoblanadi — bu C1 darajaning yashirin paroli.

turns.speaker: Examiner
turns.en: Do you think technology makes people less sociable?
turns.uz: Sizningcha, texnologiya odamlarni kamroq muloqotchan qilyaptimi?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: That's a tricky question. On the one hand, it's true that many people, especially teenagers, tend to spend hours staring at their screens instead of talking face to face. On the other hand, technology arguably helps us stay in touch with people who live far away — I video-call my cousin in Korea every week, for instance. So it seems to me that technology itself is neutral: to some extent, it all depends on how each person chooses to use it.
turns.uz: Murakkab savol ekan. Bir tomondan, ko'pchilik, ayniqsa o'smirlar, yuzma-yuz suhbat o'rniga soatlab ekranga tikilib o'tirishga moyilligi rost. Boshqa tomondan, texnologiya uzoqdagi yaqinlarimiz bilan aloqada bo'lishga yordam beradi — masalan, men Koreyadagi amakivachcham bilan har hafta video-qo'ng'iroqlashaman. Shuning uchun nazarimda texnologiyaning o'zi neytral: bu ma'lum darajada har bir inson undan qanday foydalanishiga bog'liq.

content.bodyUz: Part 3 formulasi: «In general, ...» bilan umumiy boshlang, ikki tomonni ko'rsating, faqat OXIRIDA «for instance» bilan bitta shaxsiy misol qo'shing. Shaxsiy misol — tortning ustidagi gilos, tortning o'zi emas. Va yodda tuting: «to'g'ri javob» yo'q — baholovchi fikringizga emas, uni QANDAY himoya qilganingizga qaraydi.

1. **Yozing**: Part 1/2/3 dan savol tanlab, javobingizni telefon diktofoniga yozing.
2. **Umumiy tinglang**: birinchi marta baho bermasdan, shunchaki eshiting — notanish odam sifatida tushunarlimi?

5. **Qayta yozing**: bir hafta o'tib, XUDDI SHU savolga qayta javob berib, ikki yozuvni solishtiring — o'sishni o'z qulog'ingiz bilan eshitasiz.

content.bodyUz: Speaking — kompyuterga gapirasiz: jonli imtihonchi yo'q, sizni faqat mikrofon «eshitadi». Bu aslida yaxshi yangilik: hech kim sizga qattiq qarab turmaydi! Hayajon boshlanganda **4-4-4 nafas texnikasi**ni qo'llang: 4 soniya nafas oling, 4 soniya ushlab turing, 4 soniya chiqaring — 3 marta takrorlang, yurak urishi tinchiydi. Fikrlashni ham o'zgartiring: «Xato qilsam hammasi tugaydi» emas, «Xato — nutqning tabiiy qismi, tuzataman va davom etaman». Esda tuting: baholovchilar mukammallikni emas, MULOQOTNI baholaydi.

Imtihonda soatga qarab o'tirish — diqqatni o'ldiradi. Yaxshisi, vaqtni ICHKI his qilishni o'rganing:

- **30 soniya** ≈ o'rtacha tempda 55-70 so'z ≈ PRE formulali 3 gap
- **2 daqiqa** ≈ 220-260 so'z ≈ 4 bosqichli to'liq monolog

Mashq: uyda taymer qo'yib gapiring va tugagach taxmin qiling — necha soniya bo'ldi? 5-6 mashqdan keyin xatoingiz ±5 soniyagacha tushadi. Imtihonda vaqt tugashiga ozgina qolganda yakun formulasiga o'ting — chala qolgan gap yomon taassurot qoldiradi.

turns.en: Well, that's an interesting question. Let me start by saying that the person who has influenced me most is my grandmother. She taught me that patience matters more than talent. For example, she learned to read and write properly only at the age of forty, yet she became the best storyteller in our neighbourhood. So, all in all, I'd say her example still guides me today — and that's basically my view on it.

Masalan, u o'qish-yozishni bor-yo'g'i qirq yoshida to'liq o'rgangan, shunga qaramay mahallamizdagi eng zo'r hikoyachi bo'lib tanilgan. Xullas, umuman olganda, uning namunasi meni bugun ham yo'naltirib turadi — mening bu boradagi fikrim shu.
